add.title: Task: complete on a subtask that was started with a dir and an agent leaves it 'running' (completed_at set, ran_ms 1)
add.why: core/Page/tasks/page-mastermind/task.jsonl: core-page-navigation-one-rule-written-do was started at line 92 ({start:{}, dir:'nav-rule/', agent, session_id}). It was completed three times (lines 110, 116 and one more, all ok:true), and its child dir nav-rule/ is complete, yet the replay still says state running. Its sibling core-page-parts-part-view-and-part-file, completed the same way, did go complete.

add.title: TaskView.row: give each verb button a fixed slot so the controls line up down a list
add.why: A row shows only the verbs its state allows (idle: start and stop; waiting: stop and approve), so the stop button sits in column 2 on one row and column 1 on the next, which looks ragged at 1920 (session-is-a-task review, finding 10, on the session page's feed).

add.title: Task's new `completion` getter shadows a list member with id "completion"
add.why: Since 5c88565d9, smoke FAILs /framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/dictation-debug/chat-v2/renderer/ (and inbox/) with `List — insert(): "completion" is already a property name on the list or its owner — refused` (core/List/List.js:164): an item with id "completion" (likely the 2026-10-20 completion task) is dropped where a Task owns the list. The console-allow entry expired 2026-10-17, so it blocks merge.mjs for any branch touching such a page. Found by mastermind-chat-v2, 2026-10-25.
